summary: Dragon Dreams is a 2008 studio album by Canadian singer-songwriter Jane Siberry, released under the name Issa. The album artwork describes it as "the first of a story told in three parts." Jane Siberry wrote, produced, and arranged the music, and all references to the artist on the recording use the name Issa.
one_line: Dragon Dreams is a 2008 studio album by Jane Siberry released under the alias Issa, described as the first part of a three-part story.
key_facts: Dragon Dreams is a studio album released in 2008.
Dragon Dreams was released by Canadian singer-songwriter Jane Siberry under the name Issa.
According to the album artwork, Dragon Dreams is "the first of a story told in three parts."
The music of Dragon Dreams was written, produced, and arranged by Jane Siberry.
All references to the artist on the Dragon Dreams recording are under the name Issa.
